name: Kinda SEO Manager
author: SEO Kinda

sections.description:
Kinda SEO Manager is a fast, lightweight SEO management plugin for WordPress. Take control of your site’s search visibility without bloat.

Features

  • Meta Titles & Descriptions: Configure custom search titles, snippets, and length indicators.
  • Social Sharing Previews: Customize Open Graph (Facebook) and Twitter Cards images and titles.
  • Schema Markup (JSON-LD): Add structured data and knowledge graph organization schema.
  • Search Engine Indexing: Easily set robots tags (noindex / nofollow) per post, page, or taxonomy.
  • Magic Optimizer Integration: Connect your API token for automated meta optimizations and image alt text management.

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to our external SEO AI Engine API (https://seoapi.aquiltechlabs.com) via https://seokinda.com to synchronize AI-generated meta titles, meta descriptions, image ALT text recommendations, and schema markup when the user connects an API token.

  • Service Website: https://seokinda.com/
  • API Endpoint: https://seoapi.aquiltechlabs.com/api/public/plugin/seo-data
  • Support Contact: contact@seokinda.com
  • Terms of Service: https://seokinda.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://seokinda.com/privacy-policy
  • Data Transmitted: When you trigger “Sync Data from SEO API”, your configured API token is transmitted to fetch optimization recommendations. No sensitive user personal data or credentials are submitted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kinda-seo-manager folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Kinda SEO in the admin sidebar to start configuring your SEO settings.
sections.faq:
How do I get an API token for Magic Integration?

Visit https://seokinda.com/ to onboard your brand. Once your website is registered and analyzed by the AI engine, navigate to the WordPress Plugin section in your portal sidebar to generate your unique API token.

Does this plugin work with custom post types and taxonomies?

Yes! Kinda SEO Manager automatically adds SEO metaboxes and term fields to all public post types and public taxonomies.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin is built to be lightweight with minimal queries and zero external dependencies on frontend page loads.
